description: Aljal Ipsi (알잘 입시): List what the data covers, grouped, in Korean: coverage (how many universities and which entrance years), the universities (optionally by region), the academic fields (계열), the major groups (과그룹, e.g. 간호·보건, 컴퓨터·소프트웨어), or the majors in one field or group with university counts and seats. Use it to see which universities and majors are available, or to find the Korean names that search_admissions matches. Major lists show up to 30 entries, largest seats first, each with an id for get_admission_details and the page URL. Results are in Korean. 학교·계열·과그룹·학과 목록입니다.

field.description: Optional academic field name in Korean to narrow groups or majors, e.g. "의약·보건", "공학", "인문". 계열.

group.description: Optional major group name in Korean to narrow majors, e.g. "간호", "컴퓨터", "경영·회계". 과그룹.

list.description: What to list: coverage (current scope), schools (universities), fields (계열), groups (과그룹), or majors (학과, narrow with field or group).

region.description: Optional region in Korean to narrow schools, e.g. "서울", "경기", "부산". 지역.

name: browse_admissions
title: 입시 목록 보기
